properties.title: Glider CHLA profile metrics (0–200 m, 10 m bins) with OLCI matchups
properties.description:
CHLA metrics from 20 IOOS Glider DAC deployments (Slocum and Spray gliders; Mar 2024–Oct 2026) in six regions (California Current, Mid-Atlantic Bight and slope, Southern New England shelf, off Cape Hatteras / South Atlantic Bight, Antarctic Peninsula, tropical Atlantic), one row per deployment and 3 h window of local solar time keeping one glider profile per window, depth-binned 0–200 m in 10 m bins (A < depth <= B) from samples passing the dataset's QC flag, and divided by the Sauzède et al. fluorescence:chlorophyll ratio (column chla_ratio), as for OOI. The raw fluorometer bins (CHLA_FLUOR_A_B) and a deep (dark) offset (dark_offset, not subtracted) are kept as columns. Source: IOOS Glider DAC ERDDAP. Matched to Sentinel-3 OLCI Level-3 4 km Daily Rrs (OLCIS3A_L3m_ERR_RRS, OLCIS3B_L3m_ERR_RRS; 11 bands 400–709 nm) for every profile on a day with an OLCI file (to 2026-10-01): the file of the profile's UTC day, nearest 4 km cell, S3A first then S3B. Columns pace_granule and pace_Rrs_valid flag whether the profile also has a PACE match, so OLCI can be compared with PACE on the same profiles or used on its own. OLCI Rrs is NaN where the pixel was masked.

How to load

ASSET_URL use 'Copy URL' on left

Python df = pandas.read_parquet('ASSET_URL')

R  df <- arrow::read_parquet('ASSET_URL')
